races.paceDynamic: Miss Doyenne and Hathaways Cottage will contest the early lead, with both natural front-runners likely to go at it from the start. Cool Native sits just behind in the prominent position, while a large field of hold-up horses including Ri Ra, Infinity Succes, and Mercurial Sea will track the pace. The early battle between the leaders should create an honest gallop over this stamina-testing 2m4f trip, setting up the race for those who can stay and finish. This pace scenario clearly favours the prominent racers and strong stayers who can capitalize on the early burn-up between the front two.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Duel Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Doyenne and Hathaways Cottage engage in a sustained battle from early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable as both leaders commit, opening the door for horses with finishing kicks who've been conserving energy. Strong stayers like Infinity Succes and Whispering Hopes can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Dominant Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Doyenne or Hathaways Cottage establishes clear superiority early
scenarios.body: The winner gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo, making it difficult for closers to reel them in over this demanding distance. Class and stamina prove decisive with the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Cool Native settles perfectly behind the battling leaders
scenarios.body: The Gordon Elliott-trained mare gets the ideal trip in behind, benefiting from the strong pace while avoiding the early duel entirely. Her class and tactical position prove optimal for victory.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Outsider Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes too slow early
scenarios.body: A bigger-priced hold-up horse with untapped potential like Forever And A Day or one of the lightly-raced runners finds significant improvement. The lack of early pace allows an outsider to produce a devastating late run.

races.paceDynamic: Brother Hollie will take them along from the front with minimal pressure, as no other confirmed pace-setters are evident in this field. The majority prominent runners (Circus Act, Boston Fire, Party Pack, Queen Nel, Justicialism, Kp's Ladyofknock) will sit just behind in a loose pack, while the hold-up horses (Dairy Force, Kalsman, Urbs Intacta Manet) and Pleasureofpressure track from the rear. With Brother Hollie likely getting an uncontested lead over this staying trip, the race will develop into a tactical affair with plenty left for a finish. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick from the 2f pole, as they'll have the best of both worlds - cover from the lone leader but close enough to respond to any acceleration.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie sets a steady tempo without serious challenge early
scenarios.body: The prominent pack get the perfect stalking trip and can time their challenges perfectly from 2f out. Those sitting in the sweet spot behind the leader capitalize on his honest pace-setting.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too early or get caught in traffic
scenarios.body: Dairy Force and Kalsman get the gaps they need in the final furlong as the pace collapses. Their superior class ratings (OR 104 and 93 respectively) tell when the race becomes a pure stamina test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie gets too easy a lead and kicks clear approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: His uncontested advantage becomes decisive as the field struggles to peg back his margin. The prominent runners find themselves chasing shadows despite being well-positioned.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of prominent runners creates interference and bunching
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial and several runners getting hampered. An outsider from an unlikely position capitalizes on the mayhem ahead.

races.paceDynamic: Hitthehayson will control this race as the lone front runner, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure from other early leaders. The prominent runners Irish Champ, Jukebox Johnny, Stardhem and Couldntmakeitup will track behind but none are aggressive enough to challenge for the lead early. A large hold-up contingent including Spellacy's Cross, King Gris, Only For Our Man and others will need the pace to collapse late to get involved. scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably fast or Hitthehayson stops quickly after his recent chase campaign.
scenarios.body: This allows the back markers to close dramatically, with Spellacy's Cross or King Gris using their finishing kicks to full effect. Several hold-up horses could be involved at the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fade concerns materialise
scenarios.trigger: If multiple runners with stamina doubts or 'fades in finish' warnings hit the wall simultaneously.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test where honest stayers like Stardhem can pick up the pieces late. Form and ratings become less relevant than pure stamina.

races.paceDynamic: Sphagnum leads the early pace setting with Knocknagoran Lady, Artic Chief, Duce Bigalow, Jack Inthe Jukebox, Head For Home and Imbolc all showing prominent tendencies in a field dominated by hold-up horses. With only one confirmed front-runner and six prominently-ridden horses, the early pace will be steady rather than punishing, allowing the large contingent of hold-up horses to settle and travel comfortably. The race will develop into a staying test over the final mile as the prominent horses begin to weaken and the hold-up brigade make their moves. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can quicken from off the pace in the final stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady as expected with Sphagnum and the prominent runners not going fast enough
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses get the perfect scenario to close strongly in the final stages, with the classier ones having too much finishing kick for the pace-setters. Quality hold-up horses with good recent form will dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Fight Back
scenarios.trigger: If Duce Bigalow and Head For Home show improved stamina and the pace becomes more searching
scenarios.body: The prominent horses put enough pressure on to stretch the field and tire some hold-up horses, allowing the better prominent runners to hold on or the strongest hold-up horses to still prevail. Recent form becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is exceptionally slow with the prominent runners going too steady
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where only the hold-up horses with the best turn of foot can win, favouring those with recent good form over trip and going. Late pace will be fierce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Sphagnum gets an uncontested lead and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Sphagnum to dictate throughout and kick for home before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. Only realistic if the prominent runners are unusually quiet.

This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close to Meet And Greet and avoid the scramble behind.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems or jumping errors compromise the main contenders
scenarios.body: One of the unconsidered hold-up horses benefits from a clean passage and superior stamina reserves to grab victory in the final strides. Astley's recent second suggests he could be the value play.

races.paceDynamic: Neon Diamond will likely lead or share early duties with prominent runners Brucejack, Aclass, and The Gradual Slope, creating a measured gallop over this staying trip. The lack of genuine speed horses means the pace will be sustainable rather than searching, allowing the field to stay reasonably compact through the middle stages. This sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to deliver their challenge, as Gatsby Grey, Beggars Rock, Hello Jack, Goody Four Shoes, and Tonaghneave Well can all be produced with late runs. The tactical verdict strongly favours hold-up horses who can quicken off a solid but undemanding gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady and competitive without being fierce

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the gallop becomes very sedate with multiple prominent runners sharing duties
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and current form matter most, negating tactical advantages. Any horse with a turn of foot can capitalise regardless of running style.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.body: The leader can build an unassailable advantage while others are content to wait, making the late challenge come too late. Patient tactics backfire when the pace is too generous.

races.paceDynamic: Tell Nobody Nothin and Hit The Frame will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both having confirmed leading tendencies and unlikely to yield easily. Le Grand Vert, Dinoland, Sampoet and Snow Punt will track the pace, creating a strong group just behind the leaders through the early stages. The sustained tempo over 3m2f will stretch the field and expose stamina limitations, particularly with 18 runners creating natural traffic problems for hold-up horses. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders duel hard and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will set up perfectly for horses like Le Grand Vert, Dinoland and Sampoet to strike late having conserved energy in behind. Hold-up horses will find too much ground to make up with the strong early pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Tell Nobody Nothin or Hit The Frame gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The winner will steal crucial lengths early and maintain just enough in reserve to hold off late challengers. The 3m2f trip suits both leaders' stamina profiles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is truly frantic and collapses dramatically
scenarios.body: Hardy Diamond with Jack Kennedy aboard could time a perfectly judged late run to sweep past tiring leaders. The class rider's tactical nous becomes decisive in a messy race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems and falls disrupt the fancied runners significantly
scenarios.body: Horses like Plain Or Battered or Royal Time could capitalize on a clear passage while others get hampered. The large field creates multiple opportunities for interference.
